title: Greatness as the Bearing Realm of Every Father
description: Why the inmost Divine is called "Father of Greatness" — Greatness is the Great Land that bears up all who dwell within it, while the Father is the first-established source standing within it. This Father–Greatness pattern repeats at each discrete degree below: Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Pillar of Glory, and the five holy gods are each called "Father" because each is the primal establisher of a bearing realm beneath him.
